name: Back Office Customers
description: Customer list with search and sorting, visits and spend, a side panel for team notes, and a mailing-list export that only includes people who opted in.
usage: Give it the /admin/customers route. Build the list from your bookings or orders data, save notes in onNotesChange, and use onExport only for people who agreed to marketing. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
